title: Re-close grace pin test never stamps closed_notified_at, so it passes even if extend_vacancy drops the NULL-clear it claims to guard
evidence:
+/// Pins the extend → re-close cycle: extend_vacancy MUST clear
+/// closed_notified_at, or a re-closed vacancy's stale stamp (already >7 days
+/// old) would win the COALESCE and void the second grace period. If a future
+/// edit drops that NULL-clear, this test fails.
...
+     SET status = 'closed', closed_via = 'auto',
+         closes_at = now() - interval '" <> ago <> "'
detail: The test's stale-stamp scenario requires closed_notified_at to be set before extend, but auto_close_with_closes_at never sets it (only manual closes stamp it, per the diff's own comments). The stamp is NULL throughout, so every assertion passes with a broken extend_vacancy.
recommended_fix: Stamp closed_notified_at explicitly (manual close or direct UPDATE) old enough to exceed 7 days at the second sweep; seed the draft after the first sweep so the stale stamp would actually delete it.

title: New comment asserts closes_at is NOT NULL, but the replaced predicate explicitly guarded IS NOT NULL — one of them is wrong
evidence:
-    OR (v.closes_at IS NOT NULL AND v.closes_at <= now())
+--     zombies (closes_at is NOT NULL, so the COALESCE always lands
+--     somewhere real).
detail: The old query's IS NOT NULL guard implies closes_at is nullable; the new comment's 'no draft zombies' argument rests on it being NOT NULL. If nullable, a closed row with NULL stamp and NULL closes_at never matches either branch and its drafts are never swept.
recommended_fix: Verify the vacancy.closes_at column nullability against the schema. If nullable, either handle the NULL/NULL COALESCE case explicitly or delete the 'no draft zombies' claim from the comment.

evidence:

detail: The erasure-view copy was updated to the 7-day period, but this diff touches only the email's doc comment, which still names vacancy close as the applicant-facing promise. title: Active-but-expired case (status not 'closed', closes_at past) is no longer exercised; both new close helpers force status='closed'
evidence:
-  // Still-active status but closes_at already passed (auto-close window)…
-  let assert Ok(past_id) = test_db.seed_vacancy(db, landlord_id, True)
+     SET status = 'closed', closed_via = 'auto',
+         closes_at = now() - interval '" <> ago <> "'
detail: The old test proved the time-based branch deletes drafts from a vacancy whose status is still active. The rewritten test only exercises the second OR branch with status='closed' rows, leaving the documented ≥7-day lifecycle-outage edge — deletion from an open, still-extendable vacancy — without any coverage.
recommended_fix: Add one case with status left active and closes_at 8 days past, asserting the sweep deletes its draft, restoring the dropped coverage of the status-agnostic time-based branch.
